context: A weekend bookstore. Yuki and Asuka recognize each other — they were in the same high school class.
purpose: high-school friends reuniting in adulthood — small surprised reconnection

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: え、あすか？同級生のあすかでしょ？
lines.en: Eh, Asuka? You're Asuka from my class, right?
lines.style: Office woman bright startled recognition, the warm surprised reunion-energy, soft real pleasure threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ゆき！うわ、本当に久しぶり！
lines.style: Teacher warm bright reunion explosion, the rare unprofessional spontaneity audible, soft real joy threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 何年ぶり？十年は経つよね。
lines.en: How many years? Must be ten.
lines.style: Office woman warm calculating wonder, the time-shock audible, soft real warmth threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 経つ経つ。あすかは今、先生になったよ。
lines.en: It's been, it's been. I became a teacher now.
lines.style: Teacher warm casual update sharing, the dropping into old-friend register audible, soft real joy throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: えー、すごい！似合うね、ほんと。
lines.en: Eh, amazing! It suits you, really.
lines.style: Office woman warm genuine compliment, the bright recognition audible, soft real admiration threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ありがと。ゆきは？お仕事は？
lines.style: Teacher warm reciprocal curiosity, the genuine interest in the old friend audible, soft real warmth threading throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 会社員。普通に営業やってる。
lines.en: Office worker. Just doing regular sales.
lines.style: Office woman warm casual self-update, the gentle modesty audible, soft real ease threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今度、ゆっくり飲もうよ。連絡先教えて。
lines.en: Let's grab a drink slowly sometime. Tell me your contact info.
lines.style: Teacher warm easy continuation, the genuine wanting-to-reconnect audible, soft real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うん、絶対！変わらないね、あすか。
lines.en: Yes, absolutely! You haven't changed, Asuka.
lines.style: Office woman warm warm continuation, the genuine reunion-joy audible, soft real friendship threading throughout delivery.
